name: Fluent Boards
notes: One board for the website, where the team and clients put requests and feedback. Work moves from To-Do to In Progress, then to Done (please check) so the person who asked can confirm, and only then to Closed. Add more boards the same way: one per area of work, with a check step before Closed.

fluentboards_boards.title: Website
fluentboards_boards.description: Plans, requests and feedback on the website's design, features and user experience.
